messages:
oliver: following the pm, i'm consolidating follow-ups for streaming/chat reliability. we saw repeated partial streams and client-visible truncations over the last 2 weeks. want to lock owners, short ETAs, and a canary plan.

oliver: quick summary of observed failure modes:
1) reverse proxies dropping idle connections at 15s during slow model token generation -> server flushes partial frames.
2) clients retry logic is inconsistent across SDKs (some retry forever, some never).
3) metrics weren't capturing 'session opened but no tokens emitted' windows — blind spot.

oliver: proposed remediations (owner / ETA):
- hema -> proxy config audit + update nginx/traefik idle/read timeouts + rollback playbook (due: 2026-04-04)
- taylor -> SDK retry policy harmonization (JS + Python) + opt-in polling fallback experiment (due: 2026-04-09)
- zane -> telemetry: add gauge 'session_first_token_delay_ms' and alert when p95 > 3000ms, plus synthetic test (due: 2026-04-02)
- hema+taylor -> integration test that simulates slow upstream (stream frames delayed) and asserts no partials within SLO (due: 2026-04-07)

oliver: also want a short-term mitigation: set server websocket keepalive ping to 8s to detect dead clients faster, and set a server-side 'graceful-close' that allows a one-shot retry window for the client.

hema: I'll start by scanning our load balancer and ingress configs. initial plan: align idle/read/write to 30s for internal lb, but we'll gate via flag per-ingress. will post exact knobs by EOD.

hema: sample nginx snippet i'll propose:
```
proxy_read_timeout 30s;
proxy_send_timeout 30s;
proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
# enable proxy_http_version 1.1 and chunked transfer for streaming
proxy_http_version 1.1;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```

taylor: for SDKs i'm drafting a single policy doc + defaults. suggestion:
- max_retries=3
- base_backoff_ms=150
- max_backoff_ms=5000
- reconnect_handshake_timeout_ms=5000
Also adding a flag sdk.enable_stream_fallback that, when on, switches to polling after retries exhausted. will open PRs.

taylor: question for product: do we want fallback on by default? it changes billing and UX.

oliver: fallback off by default. opt-in experiment only. we can enable for specific customers that request higher availability over cost.

zane: telemetry plan:
- add metric session.first_token_delay_ms (histogram)
- tag by model, cluster, ingress
- synth test: send 1000 streams/min and assert p50/p95 under thresholds
I'll add a Grafana panel and an alert rule.

zane: found a recurring log pattern showing ingress resets + zero-token responses. snippet:
```
2026-03-25T14:02:12Z WARN ingress/proxy.go:120 client reset before first token ingress_id=lb-17 req=xyz
2026-03-25T14:02:12Z INFO stream/handler.go:411 emitting partial_response request=xyz tokens_sent=0
```

oliver: please add that log example to the triage checklist (ingress reset -> partial).

ops-bot: incident-ticket created: INC-1420 "streaming: ingress idle resets causing partials" assigned to hema, zane. link: https://tracker.internal/incidents/INC-1420

release-bot: heads-up: any SDK publishes require cross-team flagging. avoid publishing during the infra deployment window 2026-04-06 01:00-03:00 UTC.

hema: noted on deploy window. i'll coordinate with infra for a staged rollout.

taylor: opening draft PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/2110 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/pull/987. tagging @oliver for API decisions.

taylor: also adding unit tests + a local-only integration harness that simulates laggy token emission.

oliver: plan for canary:
- day 0: deploy proxy timeout change to 2% of ingress traffic (dedicated pool) + enable histograms
- day 1: run synthetic load and collect first-token-delay. if p95 decreases and partials drop -> expand to 20% hosted traffic
- day 3: if stable, enable SDK optional fallback for opt-in customers
owner: hema/dana (ops) + taylor for SDK toggles.

zane: scheduling the synthetic run for 2026-04-01 14:00 UTC, i'll post dashboards and a quick runbook for triage.

hema: rolling plan: I'll create a per-ingress feature flag and an ingress-config repo patch. will link PRs once ready.

oliver: governance / tracking:
- each action must have a GH issue and the label incident/streaming-reliability
- weekly 30m standup on fridays at 09:00 PT until all actions closed (owner: oliver)
- add follow-up update to the postmortem doc after each milestone

taylor: ACK. adding GH issues now.

zane: small note: we should capture client-side metrics for aborted streams too (client_disconnect_before_first_token) so we can attribute blame. i'll add a logger in SDKs.

oliver: good call. taylor, please include that metric in SDK PR.

ops-bot: update: INC-1420 status changed to 'in progress' (assignees: hema, zane).

hema: starting the ingress scan now, will post config diffs and a rollout checklist in the ticket.

taylor: PR links posted and draft changelog entries added. requesting reviews from @hema and @zane.

oliver: thanks everyone. i'll consolidate the GH issues and send a short status email to eng-leads after the first canary run. ping me if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
